fusions.name: Crooked Die
fusions.desc: Rolls a loaded die at the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dizzy Pirouette
fusions.desc: Pirouettes among your enemies, dealing 11 damage to each one within 3 tiles and knocking it back 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Round the Corner
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 20% faster while veiled: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Turnabout
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.
